title: Asymptotics of the spectral determinant of the weighted Laplacian for a sequence of compact Riemann surfaces of infinitely growing volume
summary: Let $(X,χ,k)$ be a triple consisting of a smooth, compact hyperbolic Riemann surface $X$ of genus $g$, and an $m$ dimensional unitary multiplier system $χ$ of admissible weight $k$. Our first result establishes an analogue of the prime geodesic theorem for the weighted prime geodesic counting function associated to $(X,χ,k)$.
